narrative_vs_numbers.point: Revenue YoY growth re-accelerated from 2.5% in Mar 2026 to 16.2% in Sep 2026 (₹55,992 crore).
Management claimed Q1 FY27 PAT grew 15.9% YoY to ₹14,805 crore, but reported Jun 2026 PAT shows ₹16,276 crore (12.6% YoY).
Operating cash flow dropped 45.2% from ₹122,805 crore in Mar 2025 to ₹67,325 crore in Mar 2026 despite PAT growth.

bull: Sep 2026 PAT reached ₹17,389 crore, growing 21.4% YoY.
Revenue YoY growth accelerated to 16.2% in Sep 2026, reaching ₹55,992 crore.
Leverage reduced as D/E improved from 0.70 in Mar 2025 to 0.61 in Mar 2026.
bear: Operating cash flow dropped from ₹122,805 crore in Mar 2025 to ₹67,325 crore in Mar 2026.
Dec 2025 PAT declined 2.6% YoY to ₹13,481 crore before rebounding.
Analysts pressed management on standard asset provisions for agri PSL and credit card contraction.
watch: OCF conversion trend relative to PAT in FY27.
Borrowings expansion after rising to ₹295,561 crore in Sep 2026.
Revenue YoY growth sustainability after 16.2% print in Sep 2026.
